section_anchor: Ranges worth shopping by use case
brief_summary: Horizontal 0-80g axis with three stacked coral range bands — light/fast typing, general-purpose typing, and gaming with rapid trigger — each marked with dots for the catalog switches whose actuation force anchors that band. A separate dashed caution-colored marker off to the right plots the C3 Equalz Tangerine R2's 67g actuation as a heavy outlier that falls outside all three recommended bands.
